plain.li: I'm keeping {OTHER_nameDef}'s {ITEM}. It still smells like {OTHER_objective}. I hope that never fades.
They gave me {OTHER_nameDef}'s {ITEM}. I'll carry it as long as I live.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s {ITEM} is mine to look after now. I'll keep it the way {OTHER_nameDef} would have.

blunt.li: Took {OTHER_nameDef}'s {ITEM}. Nobody else is having it.

gloomy.li: All that's left of {OTHER_nameDef} is a {ITEM}. I'm holding on to it anyway.

cold.li: I've taken custody of {OTHER_nameDef}'s {ITEM}. Practical, and something more than practical.

plain.li: {LOST}'s things are gone. The last piece of {LOST} I had. I keep reaching for it.

blunt.li: Lost {LOST}'s things. Don't want to talk about it.

gloomy.li: First I lost {LOST}. Now I've lost what {LOST} left me.

plain.li: They say I'm grown now. I don't feel different. Maybe that's what grown feels like.
I'm an adult today. I get a vote at the council. I'm going to use it.
[winter] Grown up in the middle of winter. Nobody threw a party. Somebody gave me extra soup, though.

cheerful.li: I'M GROWN UP! Nobody can tell me when to go to bed! (Somebody still will.)

gloomy.li: Grown now. Childhood went fast out here. Everything does.

cold.li: Adulthood reached. My contributions will be measured differently now. Good.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is grown. I remember the first steps, right over there. I'm not crying. I'm a little crying.
My child is an adult today. Out here. We made it this far, the two of us.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is grown. Did a good job, if I say so myself.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is grown. I just hope this world is kinder to an adult than it was to a child.
